select assets_in.*, assets.name as assetsName, assets.no as assetsNo, co.id as companyId, co.name as companyName, concat(coalesce(staff.name, adm.name), case when staff.status = '离职' then '（离职）' else '' end) as staffName, concat(ifnull(co.name, ''), case when ifnull(co.name, '') = '' then '' else '-' end, department.name) as departmentName, concat(manager.name, case when manager.status = '离职' then '（离职）' else '' end) as managerName from assets_in left join assets on assets_in.assets_id = assets.id left join staff on assets_in.staff_id = staff.id left join admin adm on assets_in.staff_id = adm.id left join department on assets_in.department_id = department.id left join company co on department.company_id = co.id left join staff manager on assets_in.manager_id = manager.id
and assets_in.staff_id = #{staffId} and assets_in.status = #{status} and co.id = #{companyId} and assets_in.purchase_no like concat('%', #{purchaseNo}, '%') and assets_in.name like concat('%', #{name}, '%')
and (assets_in.name like concat('%', #{assetsName}, '%') or assets.name like concat('%', #{assetsName}, '%'))
and assets_in.category = #{category}
order by assets_in.id desc
